title: Result.all collects every success and reports the first error when one fails
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Matching and Transformation', lists `all` among the required Result operations. The second line is the load-bearing one: two entries fail, and the collected Result must be the first failure ('no entry for zoe'), not the last. An implementation that folded right-to-left would print 'no entry for nemo' and this case would catch it.
